readerBytesIdenticalToReviewedHead: git diff --stat bf294ec7d01033cd967f45a0eb6b65c5b50ecc56 308c5b4401b18d42ed73dea80459375932e6b8e8 -- interop/remora-boundary-readers .github/workflows/remora-boundary-readers.yml prints nothing
classification: Each run record states SECOND_IMPLEMENTATION, operator EXTERNAL, maintained_by EXTERNAL and independence NOT_INDEPENDENT, exactly as the pinned reader emits them. Under REMORA's lifecycle rule such a record supports REPRODUCED, not EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED.
answerExposure: Expected outcomes are inside the frozen fixtures and the reader compares against them; not answer-blind. Whether REMORA reference-verifier text was read while the reader was written is not recorded.

recomputed: each frozen package digest from its manifest member list
the SHA-256 of every retained producer input except the absent reference_verifier.py
every case outcome from the fixture inputs: call-binding refusals and single use, authority state at presentation, effect status and highest established state
test-key HMAC signatures over fixture authorizations, created and checked by the reader
readOnly: the reference_verifier.py digest, taken from the producer manifest; the file is not retained or executed
fixture premises such as revocation visibility at presentation and the observed field values, taken as supplied
expected outcomes, compared and never derived
notSupported: the effect hash rule, which returns EFFECT_UNSUPPORTED until the contract defines its preimage; no frozen case uses it

localCrossCheck: Installed CPython 3.13.3 on Linux 7.0.0, same reader revision: 41 of 41 cases match their fixtures; case results and observed outcomes equal the 3.13.15 run except callback event timestamps.
comparisonOrder: Native outputs and comparisons were emitted together by the reader in one run; this is not a separate raw-result publication.
